next.reason: 1985: 'Each literal-1 or the data item referenced by identifier-2 represents one delimiter. When a delimiter contains two or more characters, all of the characters must be present in contiguous positions of the sending item, and in the order given, to be recognized as a delimiter.' §2023:14.9.48.4 GR9 repeats both sentences ('must' becoming 'shall'). Its added sentences cover zero-length delimiters, which reach no 1985 program 2023 accepts: §2023:14.9.48.3 SR1 bars a zero-length literal and §2023:14.9.48.3 SR10 bars a variable-length group as identifier-2 (the latter refusal belongs to the operand rule, not this one). Same recognition of delimiters.
